newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs capped by 138.10 resistance.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs capped by 138.10 resistance.

text.p: September BTP futures will browse in a cosy range on Thursday, awaiting for inspiration to push above the nearby resistance at 138.10, technical analysts said.
The market blipped up on Wednesday to an intraday high of 138.13, bumping into overhead resistance there.
An analyst at an Italian bank in London said BTPs would likely stay in the 138.10-137.70 range for a while, seeking fresh guidelines, possibly from the U.S. GDP data due later.
"A break of 138.10 would suggest a move to 138.44 or a break of 137.70 would mean 137.10 by the end of the week," he said.
By 0755 GMT, September BTPs stood 0.03 higher on the day at 138.05.
The analyst said the market was likely to go higher if T-bonds continued to rally. But Thursday's auction of 3-year and 5-year BTPs would weigh on the Italian market.

A move below 137.10, the high on July 14, would push BTPs down to around 136.80 which is the top of the previous range, while a spike above the contact high of 138.44 would open the way for Fibonacci projections of 138.88 and 139.20.
Chase analysts said a break below 137.75 would trigger near term corrective activity putting 137.15 under pressure.
They said in a research note moves above 138.13 would allow a test of the 138.35 barrier and then the 138.44 high.

"Gains through the high will resume the long term uptrend opening upside potential towards the upper boundary of the long term ascending channel where major trendline resistance now intervenes at 139.43 on daily charts," Chase analysts said.
September eurolira futures were 0.02 up on the day at 93.32.
